prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original AAA game protagonist concept exploration sheet, variant 01 of 15 for MeridianSquad.
Create a beautifully designed premium professional character concept art sheet for a realistic dark near-future first-person shooter set in 2043. This is one original adult human operative of MERIDIAN, a secret government unit of specially trained people with innate extraordinary abilities. The character's face must be COMPLETELY concealed in every view, including eyes, ears, neck and all skin. Practical near-future equipment, not a space soldier, superhero or borrowed franchise design. All appearance is a proposal.
VARIANT 01 / CUTLINE. Compact waist-length plate vest, fitted stretch sleeves, tapered combat trousers. Low clipped-edge helmet; wide externally opaque smoked dark visor; shallow hard lower face mask over a sealed neck liner. Separate small front/back armor plates, soft flanks, two flat belt equipment cells, clear unarmored shoulders for rifle stock seating. Signature clipped-corner cuff reinforcement and split knuckle glove pads. Graphite, ash and restrained dull olive; sophisticated large shape hierarchy, visible layered construction, practical closures, lightly worn rubber and matte composite, tactile technical fabrics. Realistic proportions, normal human musculature, credible hands, boots and joint mobility. No visible eyes or flesh. No luminous electronics, power-device gauntlets, logos, rank or national flags.
COMPOSITION: landscape 3:2 high-resolution concept sheet on warm light gray background. Dominant full-body three-quarter front figure occupies the left half. Smaller coherent full-body rear figure near center-right. Two beautifully rendered detail insets on the far right: closed masked head and worn glove/sleeve cuff. Same exact outfit construction and palette across views. Both standing figures include complete head and both boot soles with ample margins. Empty relaxed hands held clear of waist, no weapon, no holster, no dramatic action. Elegant controlled editorial spacing, no clutter. Header in restrained crisp English typography: "MERIDIAN / 2043", then "01 / CUTLINE". No other text needed.
FINISH: highest quality polished hand-painted concept art, exceptionally convincing material rendering and anatomical construction, precise thoughtful gear design, subtle brushwork, soft directional studio lighting with clear tonal separation in dark materials. Front and rear are character design studies of the same outfit, not different people. This is a premium game art exploration, not a generic tactical catalog photograph or line diagram. No cinematic fog, dark background, glowing eyes, skull motifs, spikes, overly massive armor, fantasy machinery, exposed face or skin.
